description: Precomputed decisions. Classes: fixed-architectural (authoritative source, do not reconsider without evidence of incompatibility), verified-reusable (an existing, checked artifact or release to reuse), implementation (a reversible choice already made for the first slice), runtime-situational (resolved per run, e.g. the release set), unresolved (needs the owner; the agent stops that slice). 'home' says where the decision belongs: ordo (decision authority), praxis (intake/derivation), dokimos (verification gate), registry, or the rehearsal repository.

decisions.title: F# typed domain engine is the sole semantic authority
decisions.statement: The F# domain engine decides legal commands, transitions, causal assertions and verification; the UI renders projections only.
constraints: UI never computes legality, evidence weight, confidence or causal truth (ADRP-004)
Replay validates every event through the engine; no browser-only validator (Boundary C)

sources.quote: Use F# domain types to make invalid generic-core state difficult or impossible to represent.

decisions.title: Forma is the design system; no independent design system

constraints: Do not register Forma tags as custom elements or add a component framework

sources.quote: Prefer Forma components; do not introduce an independent design system.
